146: // ollamaProxy creates a reverse proxy handler to the Ollama server
147: func (s *Server) ollamaProxy() http.Handler {
148: 	var (
149: 		proxy   http.Handler
150: 		proxyMu sync.Mutex
151: 	)
152: 
153: 	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
154: 		proxyMu.Lock()
155: 		p := proxy
156: 		proxyMu.Unlock()
157: 
158: 		if p == nil {
159: 			proxyMu.Lock()
160: 			if proxy == nil {
161: 				var err error
162: 				for i := range 2 {
163: 					if i > 0 {
164: 						s.log().Warn("ollama server not ready, retrying", "attempt", i+1)
165: 						time.Sleep(1 * time.Second)
166: 					}
167: 
168: 					err = WaitForServer(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
169: 					if err == nil {
170: 						break
171: 					}
172: 				}
173: 
174: 				if err != nil {
175: 					proxyMu.Unlock()
176: 					s.log().Error("ollama server not ready after retries", "error", err)
177: 					http.Error(w, "Ollama server is not ready", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
178: 					return
179: 				}
180: 
181: 				target := envconfig.ConnectableHost()
182: 				s.log().Info("configuring ollama proxy", "target", target.String())
183: 
184: 				newProxy := httputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy(target)
185: 
186: 				originalDirector := newProxy.Director
187: 				newProxy.Director = func(req *http.Request) {
188: 					originalDirector(req)
189: 					req.Host = target.Host
190: 					s.log().Debug("proxying request", "method", req.Method, "path", req.URL.Path, "target", target.Host)
191: 				}
192: 
193: 				newProxy.ErrorHandler = func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
194: 					s.log().Error("proxy error", "error", err, "path", r.URL.Path, "target", target.String())
195: 					http.Error(w, "proxy error: "+err.Error(), http.StatusBadGateway)
196: 				}
197: 
198: 				proxy = newProxy
199: 				p = newProxy
200: 			} else {
201: 				p = proxy
202: 			}
203: 			proxyMu.Unlock()
204: 		}
205: 
206: 		p.ServeHTTP(w, r)
207: 	})
208: }
